caption: MCP Client Capabilities
description: Capabilities a client may support. Known capabilities are defined here, in this schema, but this is not a closed set: any client can define its own, additional capabilities. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ClientCapabilities; 2026-07-28 ClientCapabilities).
name: mcp_client_capabilities

mcp_client_capabilities__elicitation.description: MCP member `elicitation`: Present if the client supports elicitation from the server.

mcp_experimental.description: MCP member `experimental`: Experimental, non-standard capabilities that the client supports.

mcp_client_capabilities__roots.description: MCP member `roots`: Present if the client supports listing roots.

mcp_client_capabilities__sampling.description: MCP member `sampling`: Present if the client supports sampling from an LLM.

mcp_client_capabilities__tasks.description: MCP member `tasks`: Present if the client supports task-augmented requests.

mcp_extensions.description:
MCP member `extensions`: Optional MCP extensions that the client supports. Keys are extension identifiers
(e.g., "io.modelcontextprotocol/oauth-client-credentials"), and values are
per-extension settings objects. An empty object indicates support with no settings.

Keys MUST follow the {@link MetaObject`_meta` key naming rules}, with a
mandatory prefix.

mcp_roots.description: MCP member `roots`: Present if the client supports listing roots.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
